evidence: official LeRobot ACTPolicy actually trained on low-dimensional synthetic demonstrations; no cameras or hardware

environment.note: This is the locally tested experimental combination, not a claim of upstream support. Existing PyTorch packages were reused read-only; no source patch or compatibility check bypass is used by this script.

limitations: Kinematic 2D point reach, not a physical arm, visual imitation, manipulation or real robot.
Synthetic expert controls demonstrations only. Evaluation actions come exclusively from trained policy outputs or explicit baselines.
Target is an observed environment-state input; 40 held-out episodes are disjoint from training and validation.
A small easy task can yield high success and does not establish dexterous manipulation competence.
